commands.environment: TEMP and TMP point to target/qianxing-test-temp

coverage: CCXT OCO child amendment acquires the shared account admission lock before inspecting group membership or writing the durable amendment overlay, and keeps that lock through OMS/EventLog confirmation.
CCXT single-child cancellation and untriggered native OCO group cancellation use the same account admission lock, so amendment and cancellation cannot both pass stale group-state checks concurrently.
The prepared amendment executor exposes a lock-held entry point while preserving the existing self-locking entry point for other connectors.
scope_limitations: This is local Windows service test evidence; it does not establish exchange-side atomicity or behavior under an actual venue race.
No private exchange API was called and no order was changed.
Binance group amendment and OKX/Bitget Sandbox lifecycle acceptance remain unverified.
